description: CLOSED WITH EVIDENCE, NO FIX (f0988d51e, 2026-07-03). MEASUREMENT: an env-gated debug probe at TypeInterner::intern checked every interned Descr's map DNF for duplicate, provably-empty (emptiness::map_clause_empty), and structurally-subsumed clauses. Corpus: all 556 fixtures2/*.fz + fixtures2/behavior/*.fz via fz2 interp, plus the full lib suite (1150 tests). Result: ZERO smelly map interns. Independently REPRODUCED by the evidence audit with its own probe design (also zero across the same corpus). CONSTRUCTION GAP CONFIRMED REAL BUT DORMANT (both implementer and auditor proved it at unit level): a map intersect whose common field meets to empty retains the doomed clause in the interned DNF (Types::is_empty still decides correctly downstream); a subsuming union pair keeps both clauses. DECISION: per-field emptiness on every map intersect is not justified without a measured blowup (tuples had one: 60-clause DNF w/ 54 provably-empty). Exemption comment now lives on MapSig::intersect_pos in types/sigs.rs stating the measured fact and the re-measure trigger. Instrumentation fully reverted; commit is comment-only (+14 lines). Matrix failure set unchanged vs base (307/19, byte-identical diff).
title: MapSig has no persistence-boundary hygiene: map DNFs can accumulate duplicate/subsumed/empty clauses
